newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo bolsa Q1 volume up 82.6 pct vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo bolsa Q1 volume up 82.6 pct vs year ago.

text.p: Trading volume on the Sao Paulo bourse surged to $35.2 billion in 1997's first quarter, up 82.6 percent compared with the same period last year, the bolsa said in a statement.

Trade reached $11 billion for a daily average of $576.3 million in March, down 22.3 percent from the prior month, despite a 2.4 percent nominal rise in the market's main Bovespa index, the bolsa said.
In January and February, the bolsa posted strong 13.1 percent and 10.8 percent nominal gains respectively, for a nominal hike of 28.5 percent in the quarter, it said.
In real terms, the bolsa rose 24.5 percent in the first three months, including a 1.3 percent hike last month, it added.
The statement said the cash market was responsible for 88.3 percent of total volume in March while options accounted for 11.1 percent and futures made up 0.6 percent.
